claims: In 2026, Ramadan is expected to end on the evening of Thursday, March 19.
In 2026, the celebration of Eid al-Fitr is expected to begin immediately after sunset or on Friday, March 20.
The exact date of Ramadan's end depends on the sighting of the crescent moon.
Many sources anticipate the final day of fasting to be March 19, 2026.
